news.headline: Delcath Systems (DCTH): Analyst Consensus And 73% Potential Upside Drive Investor Interest
news.summary: Wall Street coverage on Delcath remains a Strong Buy consensus (five Buy ratings, no holds or sells) with an average price target near $21, implying roughly 73% upside versus the stock's mid-$12 trading level in late July 2026.

news.headline: Delcath Systems, Inc. Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Delcath granted equity awards (including RSUs) as material inducements to new employee hires who joined in May and June 2026, in compliance with Nasdaq's inducement-grant disclosure rule.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 2 Clinical Trial of HEPZATO in Liver-Dominant Metastatic Breast Cancer
news.summary: The first patient was dosed at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan in Delcath's global randomized Phase 2 DELUMA trial, which will enroll about 90 patients with liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer across more than 20 US/European sites to test HEPZATO plus standard of care versus standard of care alone.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings call
catalysts.detail: Delcath will report financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 and host a conference call at 8:30 AM ET on August 6, 2026.

catalysts.label: DELUMA Phase 2 breast cancer trial data
catalysts.detail: Following the July 2026 first-patient dosing, topline data from the ~90-patient Phase 2 trial of HEPZATO in liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer is not expected for at least one to two years given the trial just began enrollment.

catalysts.label: Phase 2 colorectal cancer trial primary endpoint (hPFS)
catalysts.detail: Delcath's Phase 2 trial of HEPZATO in liver-dominant metastatic colorectal cancer is expected to read out its primary hepatic progression-free survival endpoint by mid-2028, with the overall survival secondary endpoint expected in late 2028.

pulse: Delcath is a commercial-stage interventional oncology company generating growing revenue from HEPZATO KIT (FDA-approved for hepatic-dominant metastatic uveal melanoma) and CHEMOSAT in Europe, with FY2026 guidance of at least $100 million in revenue and a path to positive adjusted EBITDA. The company is now pushing HEPZATO into new tumor types, dosing its first breast cancer patient in the DELUMA Phase 2 trial in July 2026 alongside an already-enrolling colorectal cancer Phase 2 study. The stock has pulled back to roughly the $12 level in late July 2026 after 2026 revenue guidance came in below some analyst expectations earlier in the year, but sell-side sentiment remains a Strong Buy with substantial implied upside, and the next major catalyst is the Q2 2026 earnings call on August 6, 2026.
